sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Spiral Textured Chunky Gold-Plated Anti-Tarnish Hoop Earrings
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Make a subtle statement with our Spiral Texture Chunky Hoop Earrings — featuring an intricate concentric circle pattern etched across a bold crescent-shaped gold hoop. The detailed swirl texture catches light beautifully, giving a rich, handcrafted look at an accessible price.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Concentric spiral texture — artisan-inspired design
- Secure latch-back clasp — lightweight & comfortable all-day
Pairs with: Kurtis, jeans, dresses, indo-western outfits.
